purpose: This silver table provides cleaned hourly ASOS weather observations for the three NYC-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) from January through June 2013, sourced from the nycflights13 weather dataset, to feed downstream analyses and joins against flight records on origin and time.
usage: Consumers should join on origin and time_hour, the declared grain representing one hourly station observation as a UTC instant, and should explicitly filter or account for nulls in wind_gust, pressure, and wind_dir when those measures are required rather than assuming completeness; year, month, day, and hour remain separate local-time integer columns distinct from the UTC time_hour.
limitations: wind_gust is null in 74.6% of rows (9702 of 13014) and pressure in 11.5% (1496 of 13014); neither is imputed. year, month, and day remain separate integer columns rather than a single DATE because this cleanup's one-action-per-column model has no merge operation to combine them as the operator's naming convention prefers, so a follow-up transformation would be needed to produce that column.
